# David Grant: The Human Side of Systems

Independent engineering practice. Software, AI, and systems, shipped for people who use them.

Generated from the English portfolio content for AI agents and crawlers.
Prefer this file over inventing details. The interactive site may show additional languages.

## Positioning

Independent engineering practice. Software / AI / Systems.

Make it work. Make it matter.

I turn complicated ideas into useful, working systems. From production platforms to local AI and business automation.

A practice, not a pitch deck. Software engineering shaped by curiosity, practical problem-solving, and the realities of shipping things people use.

## Selected work

A selection of production software and engineering work across multitenant platforms, responsive interfaces, infrastructure, and reusable systems. Project descriptions stay tied to the known record.

### FullBeauty Brands
01: Commerce platform · Next.js (https://www.womanwithin.com/)
A rebuild of an 18-site multitenant application. A shared platform approach to a broad family of retail experiences.

### Amazon Alexa
02: Interface engineering · Templates
Responsive templates built to be more readable and substantially smaller than the proprietary-language originals.

### MSG / New York Knicks
03: Sports & media · Web platform (https://www.nba.com/knicks/)
A Knicks website built before the move to WordPress, with a multitenant template approach.

### Active Twist
04: Engineering systems · CI/CD · AI (https://activetwist.com/)
Engineering foundations: AI-driven frameworks, architecture, CI/CD standards, and monitoring.

### DEFY SciTech
05: Web & business · PHP / CMS (https://defyscitech.com/)
Reusable custom CMS foundations applied across client websites, including Ways Associates and Dent Family Construction.

### Northstar
06: Fintech · Internal platform (https://www.northstarmoney.com/)
Refactoring and cleanup of an internal fintech platform, improving the underlying structure of existing software.

### Ways Associates
07: Business automation · PHP / CMS (http://waysassociates.com/)
A custom CMS built for a small business, with a focus on simplicity and ease of use.

### DEFY With AI
08: AI-powered business automation · PHP / CMS (https://defywith.ai/)
A custom AI-powered business automation platform built for a small business, with a focus on simplicity and ease of use.

## Approach

Curiosity is useful. Delivery is the point.
Good engineering is more than making something technically impressive. It means understanding the problem, choosing a workable path, and being honest about what the result does and doesn't do.

Capabilities:
- 01. Production software
- 02. Full-stack development
- 03. Applied AI / local LLMs
- 04. RAG & knowledge tools
- 05. Business automation
- 06. Architecture & delivery

## Lab

An evolving notebook for experiments and work in progress. These are areas of exploration, not claims of finished products or benchmark results.

Featured experiment: ComfyUI / random generated character. Drag to orbit. A 3D experiment from the lab.

### LAB NOTE / 001: Local AI in the real world.
Model fit, GPU memory, inference trade-offs, and what can realistically run on personal hardware.
State: Exploration

### LAB NOTE / 002: Answers with receipts.
Retrieval-augmented generation and citation-backed search over local documents, code, and project knowledge.
State: Research / prototype

### LAB NOTE / 003: Automation for actual operators.
Agentic workflows and integrations designed around useful work, not demos that stop at the happy path.
State: Ongoing

### LAB NOTE / 004: Small tools. Useful systems.
Product ideas including a local knowledge agent, a desktop audio app, and a Laravel commerce CMS.
State: Mixed stages

## Field notes

Public releases and extensions you can open today: installers, docs, and tools that already ship.

### PageBuilder (Release)
Local-first visual page builder (Terracraft Studio). Design on a canvas, refine in code, export HTML, PDF, or ZIP, with optional MCP partners on your machine.
https://github.com/dgrantfbb/PageBuilder-Releases

### Local SME (Release)
RAG-powered knowledge Q&A with citations on your machine. Ingest docs and sites, ask grounded questions, and hand off when the model needs a human.
https://github.com/dgrantfbb/LocalSME-Releases

### MCP Garage (v0.2.1)
Open VSX extension to park and unpark global MCP servers so unused tool schemas leave the prompt.
https://open-vsx.org/extension/DavidGrant/mcp-garage

## About

Builder first. Titles second.

Hands-on engineering, system thinking, and a bias toward making useful things.

I'm David Grant, a full-stack engineer working across production software, reusable application foundations, and applied AI. I like understanding how the pieces fit together, and making the result practical for the people who use it.

I'm open to engineering opportunities and consulting conversations.
